description: Find frames that visually look like a reference frame using Apple Vision image feature prints. Accepts a frame assetId or a direct framePath and returns structured matches with local file paths removed. Set openGallery=true to also write a local HTML gallery and open it in the browser. [~30-60s, vision comparison]

openGallery.description: Opt in to save an HTML gallery of the top matches to disk and open it in the default browser. Default false: only structured JSON is returned, no gallery file is written and no browser is launched.

videoIdOrUrl.description: Optional video scope for similarity search

name: findSimilarFrames
